claim_limit: An owner-authorized, product-shaped non-product placement probe proves thirteen pinned facade vectors, post-handoff-only reachability of the VM logical-PC helper and C2 root walker, and 728 bytes of actual E000 margin. Link 27, full product gates, hardware acceptance and promotion remain not-run; no release claim is made.

product_window_identity.rule: The one authorized Link 27 product closure consumes this placement-probe identity before LTO and must reproduce all 8192 window bytes exactly; rebinding it after the product link is forbidden.

hardware_facts.map_rule: MAP selects eight 8-KiB slabs and overrides legacy banking mechanisms.

typed_event.rule: capture code and event-time modifiers from one queue head, then dequeue exactly once

frame_irq_candidate.status: primary candidate; bounded probe must select and pin the actual source

capacity_model.pass_rule: Every category is reported, arithmetic closes exactly, and future_margin_bytes is greater than zero.
capacity_model.memo_4_5k_status: gross upper bound before replacement residents; not a result claim

transition_rules: cold boot, CRT startup and C2 staging retain the KERNAL
typed input, abort, frame IRQ, output and owned vectors are verified before unmap
interrupt delivery is masked only for the bounded MAP/vector commit
product-owned is published only after mapping, vectors, abort and frame sources verify
freezer return verifies mapping and vector generation before any product instruction resumes
platform reset returns to the firmware-owned boot world

fail_closed.after_unmap: do not resume product execution; require documented disk reboot

run_stop_abort.handoff_rule: new queue or matrix source is proven before STKEY 0x91 is retired
run_stop_abort.masked_window_rule: a pending abort is latched and delivered before the next evaluator step

frame_source.handoff_rule: owned source is installed and advancing before the firmware-maintained source is retired
frame_source.observation_rule: one monotonic product counter; switching sources may not hide duplicate, backward or missing transitions

continuity_invariants.publication_rule: vector target bytes and their mapping become valid before the vector is published

input_and_keymap.run_stop_meaning: abort running evaluation to a usable REPL; idle no-op; never an editor binding
input_and_keymap.documentation_rule: No physical modifier binding is documented until injected queue cases and a real-key hardware sample pass.

interrupt_and_output.frame_source_selection: bounded probe selects and pins one owned source; VIC raster IRQ is the primary candidate
interrupt_and_output.irq_rule: acknowledge only the owned source, preserve machine context, never call Lisp and never allocate
interrupt_and_output.nmi_rule: no evaluator work; Freezer return makes mapping validation unavoidable
interrupt_and_output.chrout_rule: audited CRT CHROUT may execute before main; no post-startup CHROUT edge is legal
interrupt_and_output.reset_rule: cold boot and hardware reset retain firmware mapping; unmap is a post-boot product transition

fixed_cross_domain_facade.rule: Code in the owned E000 window reaches moving Bank-0 implementations only through thirteen fixed three-byte tail-jump vectors. The original twelve addresses remain unchanged; c2_facade_gc_mark is appended for the C2-owned block root walker. All E000-referenced Bank-0 and zero-page state has explicit linker placement.
link_rules: each vector address is a pinned contract value; the thirteenth vector c2_facade_gc_mark is fixed at 0xb5c6
the vector and fixed-state sections are explicitly placed under orphan-handling=error
the five-byte kb_cursor_off helper is pinned at 0xc218, the 40-byte c2e-cons facade target at 0xc21d, and any address or size drift is a link-gate failure
a direct E000-to-low-memory call outside the vector set is a link-gate failure
any vector or fixed-state address drift is a link-gate failure
the pre-ownership boot closure contains no edge or operand to session-only E000 code or state
vm_logical_relative_target and c2_product_gc_mark_roots live in the owned E000 code region and are unreachable before c2_kernal_take_ownership

rules: all live bytes in 0xe000..0xffff belong to named C2-owned sections or vectors
no relocation, call edge or absolute operand targets a KERNAL service or retired STKEY
every post-unmap edge into 0xe000..0xffff resolves to an owned symbol
no KERNAL, CBM-I/O or legacy GETIN object/archive member remains in the post-unmap closure
the source and disassembly census has exactly one input path, one abort source and one frame owner

freezer_fidelity.xemu_claim: non-authoritative queue/mapping dry run only; no Freezer safety PASS
prechain_smoke: one typed key event after return

required_outputs: full ownership state machine and vector table
typed queue driver and generated L-full closure
bounded_probe.next_if_green: return for review before exactly one real substitution link
bounded_probe.next_if_red: first-red stop; no cap or claim softening
